result.reviewScopeSummary: Verified Story 0 against the story, tech design, test plan, production code, tests, implementation artifacts, and configured gates. Folder restructure, source derivation-type rename, boundary enforcement, and gates are green, but two blocking Flow 6 production-path requirements remain unmet.

newFindings.title: smooth_turn_compression target defaults are accepted but not used in prompt rendering or validation
newFindings.evidence: AC-6.1/TC-6.1a require target ratios to be available for prompt rendering and output validation, and AC-6.2 requires defaults to be used when the host omits them. sdk.ts defaults ratios for smooth_turn_compression at lines 360-366, but rg shows targetMinRatio/targetAimRatio/targetMaxRatio are otherwise only in types/tests. createInferenceProvider renders the template from the caller input at inference-adapter.ts lines 57-80 and maps compressSmoothTurn directly at line 120. The production prompt lower-band-v1.ts lines 5-13 accepts only { rendering } and contains no target variables. A focused prompt probe with default inference config returned provenance prompt "lower-band-v1" and ModelCall messages containing only the fixed 80-word prompt plus the rendering text; no targetMin/targetMid/targetMax values were present. rg found no production sizeDisposition/output-validation implementation.

newFindings.title: Deterministic derivations still route through the provider and fail default-only inference drains
newFindings.evidence: AC-6.3/TC-6.3a require deterministic derivation types to avoid provider invocation. Production code still exposes composeTurnRendering and summarizeChunkDetailed on DerivationProvider at derivation.ts lines 130 and 138-141, includes them in PROVIDER_OPERATIONS at lines 151 and 153, maps them to ModelCall-backed callKind in inference-adapter.ts lines 119 and 121, and invokes them from real derivation handlers at turns/internal/derive.ts lines 254 and 349-352. A focused default-only inference config drain produced failed_terminal for w-t1-turn_derivation-v1 with reason `invalid_request: no assignment for derivation type "turn_rendering"`; only the smoothed_prompt call reached the host. The self-review artifact also records this as transitional behavior deferred to Story 3/4, but Story 0 includes AC-6.3.

AC-0.2 / TC-0.2a: packages/lhc/src/shared-tech exists and old top-level inference/providers/shared/tech-utils folders are absent; restructure-boundaries test and verify gate pass.

AC-0.3 / TC-0.3a / TC-0.3b: production derivation vocabulary uses string derivationType, SDK no longer exports DERIVATION_TYPES, and partial inference assignments construct; assignment-config test and typecheck pass.
AC-0.4 / TC-0.4a: production derivation-type string is smooth_turn_compression; lower_band_projection remains only in the v9 stale-work migration cleanup and historical docs; migration test passes.
AC-0.5 / TC-0.5a: cd packages/lhc && pnpm run verify-all passed with 49 files and 452 tests green.
AC-0.6 / TC-0.6a / TC-0.6b: boundary checker enforces shared-tech no-domain imports and no cross-domain internal imports; pnpm run boundaries passed inside both configured gates.
AC-6.4 / TC-6.4a: default inference provider/model lane resolves to codex / gpt-5.4-mini for inference operations; assignment-config test and focused prompt probe confirm the default lane/model.
unverified: AC-6.1 / TC-6.1a: target ratios are accepted but not available to prompt rendering or output validation in production code.
AC-6.2 / TC-6.2a: default target ratios/guard config are filled as objects, but the smooth_turn_compression prompt path does not use the default target range.
AC-6.3 / TC-6.3a: deterministic derivations still invoke provider operations during real derivation, and default-only inference drains fail at turn_rendering.

productionPathFindings: AC-6.1/AC-6.2: smooth_turn_compression target ratios/defaults are configuration-only; the production adapter/prompt path does not render target tokens or validate sizeDisposition.
AC-6.3: turn_rendering and chunk_summary_detailed remain provider-backed in production handlers; a default-only inference SDK cannot drain a closed turn.
No separate fake adapter/mock path was found in real runtime code; the blockers are real production behavior and missing production wiring.
additionalObservations: Configured gates are green, so the blockers are coverage/contract misses rather than build or test failures.

The implementation and self-review artifacts explicitly note the deterministic provider-operation removal and prompt rename as deferred, but Story 0’s AC set still requires the relevant Flow 6 behavior now.
